text:
maria-csm: FYI — NovusCare's integration tests are blocked by regional egress rules. They need a temporary regional burst + IP pinning so the onboarding window finishes cleanly. Renewal flagged for Q3; want a smooth exec demo.
maria-csm: Ask: bump regional QPS to 3x baseline for eu-west-1 and ap-south-1 for 48h, add two CIDR blocks to customer allowlist, and pin traffic to our SG edge in those regions. CIDRs: 203.0.113.0/24, 198.51.100.128/25. Start ASAP, expiry 48h from approval.
ops-bot: Ticket created: INC-2026-4771. Assigned to eng-infra. ETA: initial triage in 20m.
kevin-eng: Got it. Can you confirm baseline qps and exact target per region? Also need an account id/org id for pinning.
maria-csm: Baseline is 100 qps per region (what they saw in prod test). Target: 300 qps eu-west-1 and 300 qps ap-south-1. Org ID: org_7KXb9. Business reason: finishing onboarding + enablement with execs next week.
amy-sre: Capacity check in progress. If we do 3x for 48h we can route to spare pool, canary first 10% then scale. Outline of change (will run via infra-admin):
```
PATCH /admin/v1/tenants/org_7KXb9/overrides
{
  "region_overrides": {
    "eu-west-1": {"qps": 300, "pin": "sg-edge-eu-west-1"},
    "ap-south-1": {"qps": 300, "pin": "sg-edge-ap-south-1"}
  },
  "allowlist": ["203.0.113.0/24","198.51.100.128/25"],
  "auto_revert": "48h"
}
```
amy-sre: Will run canary -> monitor token latency, 5xx, and GPU queue depth. Rollback on >=1.5% error delta or latency +30%.
kevin-eng: I'll kick off the canary in eu-west-1 now. Watching dashboards: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/tenants/org_7KXb9/traffic
sam-support: Noted. I'll flag billing for a temp-burst tag so finance can track overage and we can surface expected charge to the customer.
amy-sre: Canary 10% started in eu-west-1 — no spikes so far, 95th latency steady. Proceeding to full region roll once stable for 10m.
kevin-eng: Full rollout to eu-west-1 complete, ap-south-1 canary in 2m.
ops-bot: Change applied (INC-2026-4771) at 1719805548. Auto-revert scheduled for 1719984748 (48h). Change log: CHG-88712. ✅
amy-sre: Verified allowlist entries present on edge ACLs and routes pinned. Quick verification commands used:
```
# verify ACLs
ssh infra-edge-eu && sudo ipset test novuscare_acl 203.0.113.5
# verify routing pin
curl -s https://edge-proxy-eu.internal/health | jq .pinned_route
```
amy-sre: Monitoring for 30m, will update if anything looks off. Otherwise set to auto-revert. 👍
sam-support: I sent the billing note to finance and added a calendar reminder for post-burst reconciliation. Also scheduled the enablement session for Wed 10am PT with NovusCare — invite sent.
kevin-eng: Leaving a note in the org's config that we did a temporary spike for onboarding + renewal enablement.
maria-csm: Thanks all — I'll message NovusCare with the timeline and the support contact. Keeping this thread open for any follow-ups.
ops-bot: INC-2026-4771 closed (auto) after change applied — archived to changelog. If you need a manual rollback, reopen the ticket.
